items.title: Ollama releases: v0.35.0
items.description:
## Decision models

Ollama now supports decision models through `/v1/systemone`, based on [TypeSafe’s Jev API](https://typesafe.ai).

Decision models return choices, probabilities, and scores instead of text. Use them for tasks such as ticket triage, model routing, and content classification.

items.summary_detailed: Ollama has released version 0.35.0 which introduces support for decision models via the `/v1/systemone` endpoint, based on TypeSafe’s Jev API. These models provide choices, probabilities, and scores rather than text, enhancing capabilities in areas like ticket triage and content classification. This update broadens Ollama's application scope, making it more versatile for various decision-making processes across different industries.
